description: Front A (broad catalog), generic composition scenario, ODC lane. (1) A NEW server action returns outputs of different types and resets them to the neutral values of each type, PRESERVING two excluded outputs (KeptText, KeptCount), which only copy the inputs: a seed Assign and then a reset Assign with one assignment per non-excluded output. Reset values measured here: Text "", Integer/Long Integer/Decimal/Currency 0, Boolean False, Date and Date Time NullDate(), Time #00:00:00#, Identifier NullIdentifier(), record/structure/lists copied from a local variable of the same type that was never assigned (the default value of the type). (2) The CALL to that action is inserted in a BRANCH of an If of an INHERITED action (TrueTarget of the only If of WfCov_Project_CloseOpenTasks, which came from job:logic-steps), before the only raise node of that branch: the node is created, the output of the new node is first linked to the successor and only then is the connector of the If repointed. (3) Reads: the typed inventory of the new action (dump), the If and the new node before/after, and usages of the new action (the consumer is the inserted node). Headless: it proves the model and the Verify, not the value at run time.
